name: XMLTV-Schedules-Direct
description: An XMLTV installation based on Debian (including cron) with a JSON added grabber for Schedules Direct. This allows use of Schedules Direct for all supported countries. For those not in the know; XMLTV is a set of programs to process TV (tvguide) listings and manage your TV viewing, storing listings in an XML format. The JSON grabber currently provided with this docker is tv_grab_sd_json. Recently, it has been officially accepted into the XMLTV project.
